description: This file defines the DecryptedItem class, a specialized implementation of a decrypted data item in the system. It extends a generic item class and implements specific logic for handling decrypted payloads, including managing app data, references, and item states like pinned, archived, or locked.

classes.name: DecryptedItem
classes.description: A class representing a decrypted item with various properties such as conflict status, protection, and references. It provides methods for managing and comparing item content, accessing app data within a defined domain, and handling reference checks.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a DecryptedItem instance with a payload, setting properties based on the payload content and default app domain values.

methods.name: DefaultAppDomain
methods.description: Static method returning the default application domain constants.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Getter for the content payload of the item.

methods.name: references
methods.description: Getter for item references found in the content.

methods.name: isReferencingItem
methods.description: Checks if this item is referencing another specified item.

methods.name: getDomainData
methods.description: Retrieves domain-specific data from appData based on the provided domain key.

methods.name: getAppDomainValue
methods.description: Fetches a specific value from the default app domain within the item's appData.

methods.name: getAppDomainValueWithDefault
methods.description: Fetches a value from the default app domain or returns a default if not present.

methods.name: payloadRepresentation
methods.description: Returns a copy of the payload, optionally overridden with specified data.

methods.name: contentKeysToIgnoreWhenCheckingEquality
methods.description: Specifies content keys to ignore when checking item content equality.

methods.name: appDataContentKeysToIgnoreWhenCheckingEquality
methods.description: Specifies appData keys to ignore when checking content equality.

methods.name: getContentCopy
methods.description: Creates and returns a deep copy of the content.

methods.name: isItemContentEqualWith
methods.description: Compares this item with another to determine content equality, ignoring specified keys.
